Table J5. Original Raw-Logit and Corrected Rank-Based Permutation Tests
Note. Original predeclared test: cluster permutation exchanging raw ensemble logits. Corrected test: cluster-level rank-based adaptation of Bandos et al. (2005). Both use 5,000 permutations and Holm adjustment within the six final families; ΔAUC is identical. Decision changed = significance at 0.05 after Holm adjustment differs. X → X = within-dataset. C23/C40 = FaceForensics++ DeepFakes at compression C23/C40; CDF = Celeb-DF v2; DFo = DeeperForensics-1.0. Raw p below 0.001 is written < 0.001 and Holm p below 0.005 as < 0.005.
